items.headline: Friday sell-off: Nasdaq falls 2.86%, S&P 500 1.82%, Dow about 1.1%
items.note: Worries that heavy AI spending won't pay off hit tech, and a closely watched chip index fell 7.2%. The Nasdaq ended October with its worst monthly drop since March 2025. This is the latest full close I could confirm; I found no confirmed Monday numbers.

items.headline: Intel falls 28.58%, its worst day since 1974, on a weak forecast
items.note: Intel guided Q4 adjusted EPS to $0.25 versus about $0.43 expected, and its CFO said the PC slowdown should last through at least the first half of 2027. Data center and AI revenue still rose 78%.

items.headline: Amazon's AI spending leaves trailing free cash flow at a $42.4B outflow
items.note: Q3 EPS of $1.89 missed the $1.96 estimate, though AWS grew 39%. The stock fell about 7% before the open but closed down 1.41%. Investors now want to see AI spending turn into profit.

items.headline: Anthropic's public IPO filing is out; marketing could start the week of Nov 9
items.note: The public S-1 came on Oct 26, and Bloomberg reported (via IPOScoop) that marketing could begin as soon as the week of Nov 9. Timing and price are not set, and I haven't read the SEC filing myself. A giant AI listing could shape pay and hiring across the field.

items.headline: Reddit falls 29.22%, Roblox 18.05% and Coursera 25.54% after earnings
items.note: Roblox forecast Q4 bookings down 10-15% from last year, and Coursera guided Q4 revenue below its Q3 revenue. Another reminder that guidance, not past results, drives big moves.

items.headline: Okta joins the S&P 500 on November 4, replacing Kenvue
items.note: Index funds that track the S&P 500 must buy the new stock and sell the removed one, which is why additions often move a stock.

learn.term: S-1 filing and the IPO roadshow
learn.explain: Before a company sells shares to the public, it files a document called an S-1 with the SEC. It lays out the business, revenue, losses, risks and how the money will be used. After the S-1 is public, the company goes on a 'roadshow': executives pitch big investors to gauge demand and settle on a price range. Anthropic made its S-1 public on Oct 26, and Bloomberg reported the roadshow could begin the week of Nov 9. Shares only start trading after the SEC clears the filing and the price is set.
learn.try: Search SEC EDGAR for any company's S-1 and read just the 'Risk Factors' headings.
